Name: Hauling: Engineer's Toolbox to <Alias=SecondPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Delivery Contract. Deliver a toolbox from the <Alias=TargetLocation>, <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation> to the <Alias=FinalLocation>, <Alias=SecondPlanetLocation>. Payment on delivery.

LogEntries.Entry: A retiring engineer at the <Alias=TargetLocation> wants her toolbox taken to the apprentice she trained, who runs his own site at the <Alias=FinalLocation> now.
The retiring engineer wants her toolbox to go to the apprentice she trained, who she says will pretend he doesn't need it. I need to collect it and take it to him.
I've got the toolbox. Every tool in it has been cleaned and oiled, and the big wrench is wrapped in a cloth on its own. Now I need to take it to the apprentice.
I delivered the toolbox to her apprentice. He said he'd call her tonight.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the engineer at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Deliver the toolbox to the apprentice at the <Alias=FinalLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're the hauler? I'm retiring, and my toolbox goes to the lad I trained. The big wrench in it was my mother's.
He runs his own site now, off-world. The box is just there. Don't let him tell you he doesn't need it.
Because I'm done. Forty years of fixing other people's mistakes. My knees decided before I did.
Every tool I ever trusted. Half of them I made. Tell him to mind the wrench.
Can I help? Sorry, it's a mess.
That's her box. She actually sent it.
She wanted you to have it.
She told me I'd never be ready for this box. I'll call her tonight.
She said you'd pretend you didn't need it.
Ha. I've been borrowing a wrench for a month. Don't tell her that.
